blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — LTO chief Marcus Lacanilao on Monday called out vlogger Geo Ong for arriving at the agency’s Quezon City headquarters aboard a helicopter, reminding public figures to set a good example instead of flaunting their wealth. Ong appeared before the LTO on Monday to address alleged traffic violations in Palawan, including riding a motorcycle without a helmet. The agency earlier suspended his driver’s license for 90 days after issuing him a show cause order.
